candidates.description: This vector activates for words and subwords starting with or containing the prefix "imp-" or similar phonetic roots related to consequence, impact, and impression.
This feature vector represents terms and demonyms associated with nations, nationalities, and continents, particularly focusing on the Americas and Europe.
These tokens represent traditional English given names, predominantly of kings and historical figures.
These tokens represent various states, provinces, territories, and countries across different regions of the world.
This feature vector represents proper nouns and political or governmental terminology across multiple languages.
The tokens share a common linguistic suffix or root ending in "-ent" or related variations common in Romance languages.
This feature vector represents British geographic locations and UK-related regional proper nouns.
These tokens represent common nominal and verbal suffixes or endings in Romance languages like Portuguese, Spanish, and French.
This feature vector activates on suffixes and root morphemes common to abstract nouns and adjectives related to society, governance, and philosophy.
This feature vector activates strongly on proper nouns commonly found as American given names and place names.
